recentItems.title: Mystery Cups 🤩 KPop Demon Hunters: Ultimate Fan Show 1 | Netflix Family
recentItems.description:
This is an ad for Jazwares. It's a blind-pack sneak attack when the gang discovers there are surprise plushes inside mystery cups that look like instant ramyeon.

To build suspense and elevate the stakes, they gamify the experience and invent a cup-stacking competition that combines collectibility with strategy and suspense. Who will find all 6 characters first? And will the tower topple before they complete their collection?

Welcome to KPop Demon Hunters Ultimate Fan Show, the series inspired by the HUNTR/X mantra, "FOR THE FANS!" A gang of KPop Demon Hunters superfans gather in the ultimate clubhouse to play, create, and dish about all things KPop Demon Hunters toys and collectibles.

recentItems.title: Fruit x SWORDS! 🍉 KPop Demon Hunters: Play Games with Us 2 | Netflix Family
recentItems.description:
Things get juicy when three contestants compete to slice fruit into perfect halves using only HUNTR/X swords!

Each must take a single swipe and weigh both sides in this juicy challenge of precision and pizzazz. Will it be Rumi's Four Tiger Sword with an apple? Mira's Curved Moon Sword with a watermelon? Or Zoey's Spirit Blades with a grape?

Welcome to Play Games with Us, the series that's full of colorful competitions, challenges and fun, inspired by the iconic scene in KPop Demon Hunters.
